headline: Per-share earnings surge versus both prior periods
summary_short: EPS was INR 3.59, up 44.2% from INR 2.49 in the prior quarter and up 134.6% from INR 1.53 a year earlier.
summary_long: Only the per-share earnings figure is available on the shard. It rose 44.2% q/q and 134.6% y/y. No revenue, margin or cash figures were available from the shard, and no drivers or guidance are assessed.

The company has an April-March fiscal year, so this event is the July-September 2026 quarter. A large part of the y/y gap may reflect share-count changes or one-offs; this was not checked.
